**h01 — S3 presigned-URL refresh runner**
`s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:16`), whose `CheckAndPresign` re-presigns S3-backed attachment URLs (skips any whose `LastPresignedTime` is < 4 days old; expiry is 5 days) — `runner.go:47-132`.
Schedule: once eagerly at startup, then every 12 hours (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, `runner.go:27`; ticker loop `runner.go:29-41`).
Wiring: `Server.startBackgroundRunners` — `server/server.go:162` (construct), `server/server.go:163` (`RunOnce`), `server/server.go:169` (`Run` in a goroutine); called from `Server.Start` at `server/server.go:129`.

**h02 — Webhook delivery + SSRF protection**
Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120-180` (actual send at `webhook.go:152` via `safeClient.Do`). It is reached from `webhook.PostAsync` (`webhook.go:184`) through a bounded 128-slot channel drained by 4 worker goroutines (`webhook.go:39-55`).
Protection: a custom `http.Transport.DialContext` — `safeDialContext` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:59-77`) resolves the host at dial time and rejects reserved/private IPs, which also defeats DNS rebinding. The range list and predicate live in `internal/webhook/validate.go:14-54` (`reservedCIDRs`, `isReservedIP`, escape hatch `AllowPrivateIPs` at `validate.go:41`). A second, earlier check validates the URL at configuration time: `webhook.ValidateURL` — `internal/webhook/validate.go:62-83`.

**h03 — Identity provider abstraction / implementation**
Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go` — defines the shared `IdentityProviderUserInfo` contract; note it is a struct, not a Go interface).
Implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:19-42`, `NewIdentityProvider`, `ExchangeToken`, user-info fetch). OAuth2 is the only concrete protocol shipped. Consumed at `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:12-13`.

**h04 — Direct MySQL driver construction outside the factory**
**No.** Evidence:
- `store/db/mysql.NewDB` is defined at `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:20` and the only import of `github.com/usememos/memos/store/db/mysql` in the whole repo is the factory `store/db/db.go:8`, used at `store/db/db.go:22`.
- The only other construction of the type is a bare in-package test literal `db := &DB{}` at `store/db/mysql/auth_config_test.go:12` (test-only, not production).

**h05 — Emoji reactions on user delete**
Mechanism: **explicit Go code** (no DB-level cascade).
- Explicit deletes: `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx`, invoked from `deleteUserTargetsTx` — `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:92,98` (defs at `:359,:379`), `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:92,98`, and the MySQL equivalent in `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go`. Entry point `(*DB).DeleteUser` → `store.(*Store).DeleteUser` (`store/user_delete.go` / `store/user.go:171`).
- Absence of a DB rule: the `reaction` table has no foreign key at all — `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-99`, `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:91-98`, `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql`. The only `ON DELETE CASCADE` in any LATEST.sql is on `memo_share.memo_id` (`sqlite/LATEST.sql:109`, `postgres/LATEST.sql:108`, `mysql/LATEST.sql:108`).

**h06 — RPC handlers that can trigger an outbound HTTP call to a user-configured URL**
Handlers (all in `server/router/api/v1/`):
- `CreateMemo` — `memo_service.go:70` → dispatch at `memo_service.go:157`
- `UpdateMemo` — `memo_service.go:401` → `memo_service.go:513` → `memo_update_helpers.go:67`
- `DeleteMemo` — `memo_service.go:518` → `memo_service.go:562`
- `CreateMemoComment` — `memo_service_comments.go:20` → `memo_service_comments.go:119`
- `SetMemoAttachments` — `memo_attachment_service.go:16` → `memo_attachment_service.go:48`
- `SetMemoRelations` — `memo_relation_service.go:16` → `memo_relation_service.go:48`

Convergence: **`webhook.PostAsync`** — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` (the single funnel; the sync worker then calls `webhook.Post`, `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`). Intermediate convergence for 5 of the 6 is `(*APIV1Service).dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48`.
(Separate, non-webhook outbound path: `GetLinkMetadata`/`BatchGetLinkMetadata` → `fetchHTMLMeta` → `httpgetter.GetHTMLMeta` — `memo_service_link_metadata.go:46`, `memo_service.go:28`. Those URLs are request-supplied, not user-*configured*.)

- Route registration `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124`
- `(*FileServerService).serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`

`(*filter.Engine).CompileToStatement` — `internal/filter/engine.go:74` — **≈34–38 inbound call sites** (graph fan-in 34; 38 textual `.CompileToStatement(` sites, of which 7 are non-test: `internal/filter/helpers.go:11`, `store/db/{sqlite,mysql}/memo_relation.go`, `store/db/postgres/memo_relation.go` ×2, `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:413`, `shortcut_service.go:356`).

Premise is wrong: **neither.** There is no external message broker at all — no NATS, RabbitMQ, AMQP, or Kafka dependency in `go.mod` or any import.
